description: This file contains utility functions, class definitions, and decorators used within the PySpark SQL module, including environment checks, conversions, and dispatch mechanisms for different Spark environments.

classes.name: ForeachBatchFunction
classes.description: Wraps a user-defined 'foreachBatch' function to be callable from JVM in Spark streaming.

classes.name: StringConcat
classes.description: Utility class for efficient string concatenation with length limit.

classes.name: NumpyHelper
classes.description: Provides static methods for numpy-like operations, e.g., linspace.

methods.name: to_java_array
methods.description: Converts a Python list to a Java array using a Py4j gateway.

methods.name: to_scala_map
methods.description: Converts a Python dictionary to a Scala Map.

methods.name: require_test_compiled
methods.description: Checks if test classes are compiled, raises error if not.

methods.name: require_minimum_plotly_version
methods.description: Ensures Plotly is installed and meets minimum version requirements.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Calls the user-defined function with a DataFrame and batch ID, wrapping JVM DataFrame.

methods.name: atLimit
methods.description: Checks if the StringConcat has reached its maximum length.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a string to StringConcat, respecting length limit.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the concatenated string from StringConcat.

methods.name: escape_meta_characters
methods.description: Escapes special characters in a string for SQL.

methods.name: to_str
methods.description: Converts a value to string, with special handling for booleans and None.

methods.name: enum_to_value
methods.description: Converts an Enum to its value, recursively if needed.

methods.name: is_timestamp_ntz_preferred
methods.description: Checks if TIMESTAMP_NTZ type is preferred based on session config.

methods.name: is_remote
methods.description: Determines if running in Spark Connect remote environment.

methods.name: try_remote_functions
methods.description: Decorator to support functions in Spark Connect environment.

methods.name: try_partitioning_remote_functions
methods.description: Decorator for partitioning functions in Spark Connect.

methods.name: try_remote_avro_functions
methods.description: Decorator for avro functions in Spark Connect.

methods.name: try_remote_protobuf_functions
methods.description: Decorator for protobuf functions in Spark Connect.

methods.name: get_active_spark_context
methods.description: Returns the active SparkContext or raises error if not initialized.

methods.name: try_remote_session_classmethod
methods.description: Decorator to support session classmethods in Spark Connect.

methods.name: dispatch_df_method
methods.description: Dispatches DataFrame methods to either Connect or Classic implementations.

methods.name: dispatch_col_method
methods.description: Dispatches Column methods to either Connect or Classic implementations.

methods.name: dispatch_window_method
methods.description: Dispatches Window methods to either Connect or Classic implementations.

methods.name: dispatch_table_arg_method
methods.description: Dispatches TableArg methods to either Connect or Classic implementations.

methods.name: pyspark_column_op
methods.description: Wrapper for column operations supporting extension dtypes and fillna.

methods.name: get_lit_sql_str
methods.description: Generates SQL string literal with proper escaping.

methods.name: linspace
methods.description: Generates linearly spaced sequence of floats.

methods.name: remote_only
methods.description: Decorator marking functions or properties as remote-only in Spark Connect.
